name: Tu Hieu Pagoda
summary: Walk the pine hillside at Từ Hiếu, in Dương Xuân Thượng III, Thủy Xuân, about 5 km from the centre. Vietnam Tourism names it as the monastery where Thích Nhất Hạnh was a novice. Tự Đức gave the pagoda its name. The fee, the hours, and the ride in minutes are Check on arrival.
getThere: About 5 km, via Điện Biên Phủ and Lê Ngô Cát. Minutes are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The triple gate and the pond at Tu Hieu

notice.title: No published fee, and no published hour
notice.body: The city page and Vietnam Tourism describe the monastery. Neither prints a ticket or a closing time. Do not read that silence as free entry.

body: The city page places Từ Hiếu in Dương Xuân Thượng III village, Thủy Xuân ward, hidden in pines on the hillside, with a campus of about 8 acres and a curved ditch in front. It is about 5 km from the centre. The same page says the pagoda is the resting place of Nguyễn eunuchs, and that Tự Đức gave it the name Từ Hiếu.
Vietnam Tourism names it as the monastery where Thích Nhất Hạnh was a novice. Treat it as a working monastery after Thien Mu, not as a second citadel. The fee and the hours are Check on arrival.
The city route is Điện Biên Phủ, then Lê Ngô Cát, then the sign. Motorbike, car, or taxi. The minutes from the south bank are Check on arrival.

gettingThere: From the south bank, the city page says about 5 km: follow Điện Biên Phủ, turn onto Lê Ngô Cát, and take the sign for the pagoda. The minutes are Check on arrival.
